svg.aria-label: Vayudoot architecture: two layers meeting at a hotspot. On the left, a detection path in which satellite thermal detections and ground station readings are fetched by a periodic scan with no model and no human present, joined by citizen sensor readings, reduced to signals and grouped by centroid linkage into hotspots that are drawn as areas with a minimum radius and a confidence capped unless an independent source agrees; forecasting and federation come off the hotspot. On the right, a reporting path in which one citizen's photograph is classified by the evidence stage, held to a confidence floor, corroborated by a three-way parallel agent graph, then given a jurisdiction, drafted into a complaint, held at a human confirmation gate, filed to a sandbox outbox and tracked through acknowledgement, escalation, resolution or withdrawal, with a Right to Information application available once the statutory window lapses. A classified case also becomes a citizen report signal feeding the detection layer, and acting on a hotspot enters the reporting path at the jurisdiction stage.
svg.text: Vayudoot — the unit of work is a hotspot, not a case
Strands Agents SDK · a detection layer that needs no citizen, and a reporting pipeline that is one action available from a detection
Detection — nobody has to report anything
instruments and a scan · a hotspot exists in districts nobody has submitted from
retained in full; repositioned as an action taken about a place
two HTTP calls per point and arithmetic
off by default — a person switches the loop on
Signal — one observation at a place and a time
strength = how believed · magnitude = how bad · never confused
stored and deduplicated on the observation, not the fetch
grouping.py · centroid linkage, 2 km, a 14-day gap rather than an age
satellite and station signals are unclear — VIIRS sees heat, not fuel
a photograph upgrades a detection rather than sitting beside it
derived on every request · one signal is enough to publish
an area, never a point — radius floored at 1 km, a neighbourhood
confidence capped at 0.6 without an independent source, however
many reports there are — corroboration gates publication
not a trained predictor · never an
a node publishes what it found and
a detection layer, not trained weights
POST /reports · answers 202, the run is a background task
images.py normalises first — format by bytes, never by suffix
one agent, no tools · up to 4 photographs in one message, or a note alone
three independent entry nodes in parallel · all four on the fast tier
no tools · absent evidence is not disproof
reverse_geocode() · lookup_authority() over a JSON table — data, not code
all 28 states and 8 union territories, plus a generic fallback
→ Jurisdiction: authority, statute, window, tier, and reported coverage
cites only the statute it was handed · names no party · claims no certainty
→ Complaint: English body + a translation into the region's main language
the pipeline stops here — status: AWAITING_CONFIRMATION
nothing is filed until a person calls POST /cases/{id}/confirm
writes an envelope to a local sandbox outbox · status: filed
live filing raises rather than sends — no delivery transport is wired
in, deliberately. Every committed authority address is .invalid
6 · Tracking — the case outlives the run
a fresh window, then escalation is due again
asks the authority's PIO what is on the file · RTI Act 2005
a statutory 30-day duty to reply that the complaint never carried
its clock runs from filed_at · an acknowledgement does not restart it
a classified case becomes a citizen_report signal
one action available from a detection
judgement — reading a photograph, drafting a complaint
mechanical — call one tool, summarise what came back
human control — the pipeline stops and a person decides
Both tiers ship on Gemini — flash and flash-lite. The scan spends nothing.
A hotspot is a public claim about a place
· area granularity, never a point on a building — a 1 km floor
· confidence is capped, not merely flagged, without an instrument
· a citizen sensor is evidence, and is never corroboration
· every forecast is labelled model-derived and shows its inputs
· no responsible party is ever named, on the map or in a complaint
Hard constraint 7 · a map that can be aimed at an address is a weapon
· no delivery transport is wired in — by design, not as a gap
· every committed authority address is on the reserved .invalid TLD
· filing happens only after an explicit human confirmation
· the reporter's contact leaves on no route, and on no feed
· the scan is on a timer; escalation and RTI never are
